svg.text: Baseline site plant - placement-model axonometric (schematic: positions carry no dimension beyond the placement model)
Z-up, mm. Solid = built at this site. Dashed = eliminated by the scaling plan (function moved to the labelled replacement). Grey = block-centre massing, placement pending.
+X right-down, +Y left-down, +Z up. Source: placement_seed Rev M+.
